decisions.reason: These words sum up the covenant from the exodus on (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). Jeremiah uses them in 7:23, 11:4 and 24:7, and again in the promises of 31:1, 31:33 and 32:38.

decisions.choice: verse 22 kept, as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: The Greek translation of Jeremiah does not have this verse. The Hebrew text, which this translation follows, has it.

decisions.choice: you will be my people, and I will be your God
decisions.reason: The covenant promise is worded as in 24:7 and 11:4, here with "you" because the people are spoken to directly.

decisions.choice: the covenant formula, as in 24:7, with "các ngươi"
decisions.reason: The formula is worded as in 24:7 and the terms note's 31:33; here it is spoken to the people, so it takes "các ngươi".

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה׀סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה סַ֖עַר מִתְגּוֹרֵ֑ר עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [the] storm of Yahweh, wrath has gone out, a sweeping tempest; on [the] head of [the] wicked it will whirl.

en.L: Look, the storm of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Wrath has gone out, \q a sweeping tempest; \q on the head of the wicked it will whirl down.
en.B: Look, the storm of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Fury has burst out, \q a whirlwind sweeping on; \q it will crash down on the heads of the wicked.
en.R: Look! The anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is like a storm. \q It has broken out like a whirlwind, \q and it will strike the heads of wicked people.

es.L: He aquí la tempestad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: ¡el furor ha salido, \q una tempestad arrasadora! \q Sobre la cabeza de los malvados caerá girando.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, la tempestad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! El furor ha estallado, \q un torbellino que arrasa; \q caerá con fuerza sobre la cabeza de los malvados.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! La ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es como una tormenta. \q Ha estallado como un torbellino, \q y caerá sobre la cabeza de la gente malvada.

fr.L: Voici la tempête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! La fureur est sortie, \q un ouragan qui balaie tout ; \q sur la tête des méchants il tourbillonnera.
fr.B: Voici la tempête {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! La fureur a éclaté, \q un tourbillon qui balaie tout ; \q il s’abattra sur la tête des méchants.
fr.R: Regardez ! La colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est comme une tempête. \q Elle a éclaté comme un tourbillon, \q et elle va frapper la tête des méchants.

sw.L: Tazama, dhoruba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ghadhabu imetoka, \q tufani ifagiayo; \q itazunguka juu ya vichwa vya waovu.
sw.B: Tazama, dhoruba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ghadhabu imezuka, \q kisulisuli kinachofagia; \q kitaangukia vichwa vya waovu.
sw.R: Tazama! Hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kama dhoruba. \q Imezuka kama kisulisuli, \q nayo itawapiga waovu vichwani.

vi.L: Kìa, cơn bão của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Cơn thịnh nộ đã bùng ra, \q một cơn bão cuốn phăng; \q nó sẽ quật xuống trên đầu kẻ ác.
vi.B: Kìa, cơn bão của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Cơn thịnh nộ đã bùng ra, \q một cơn gió lốc cuốn phăng mọi vật; \q nó sẽ giáng xuống trên đầu những kẻ gian ác.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như một cơn bão. \q Nó đã nổi lên như một cơn gió lốc, \q và nó sẽ quật vào đầu những kẻ gian ác.

decisions.choice: verses 23-24 repeat 23:19-20 with small differences
decisions.reason: The two verses come back almost word for word from 23:19-20. The differences: the verb describing the tempest is not the one in 23:19 (there "whirling"; here a word for sweeping or raging), the tempest is not joined to the storm with "and", verse 24 says "the fierce anger" where 23:20 says "the anger", and verse 24 lacks the closing "with understanding" of 23:20. In chapter 23 the storm answers the false prophets; here it falls on the oppressors of verses 16 and 20.

decisions.choice: the storm of the LORD: his anger pictured as a violent storm
decisions.reason: As in 23:19, wind and storm picture God's judgment coming suddenly and with force (4:11-13; 25:32).

decisions.choice: sweeping: a tempest rushing on
decisions.reason: The form of this verb is rare. It is usually taken to describe a storm that drags or sweeps everything along; the sense is close to "whirling" in 23:19.

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:19, with "sweeping" for the different verb
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording from 23:19 so the repeat can be recognized, changing only what the Hebrew changes (m1).

decisions.choice: the Spanish wording of 23:19, with "arrasadora" / "que arrasa" for the different verb
decisions.reason: Verses 23-24 repeat 23:19-20 (meaning decision m1), so each level reuses its own Spanish wording there and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 23:19
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 23:19 with one verb changed, so each level repeats its 23:19 wording and changes only "kizungukacho" to "ifagiayo" / "kinachofagia" for the sweeping storm.

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:19, with "qui balaie tout" for the different verb
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its French wording of 23:19 so the repeat can be recognized, changing only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:19, with "cuốn phăng" (sweeping)
decisions.reason: Verses 23-24 repeat 23:19-20, so the Vietnamese of those verses is reused at each level, changing only the word the Hebrew changes.

source.text: לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־יְהוָ֔ה עַד־עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will turn back [the] burning of [the] anger of Yahweh until he has done and until he has carried out [the] purposes of his heart; in [the] latter part of the days you will understand it.

en.L: The fierce anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not turn back \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done and until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has carried out the purposes of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart. \q In the latter days you will understand it.
en.B: The fierce anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not turn away \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has fully carried out what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has purposed in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart. \q In the days ahead you will understand this.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will not stop being fiercely angry \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned. \q Later on, you will understand this.

es.L: No se apartará el ardor de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haya hecho y hasta que haya cumplido los propósitos de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón. \q En los últimos días lo {{plural_you:entenderán|entenderéis}}.
es.B: La ira ardiente {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} no se calmará \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haya cumplido por completo lo que se propuso en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón. \q En los días venideros {{plural_you:entenderán|entenderéis}} esto.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no dejará de estar terriblemente enojado \q hasta que haya hecho todo lo que planeó. \q Más adelante {{plural_you:entenderán|entenderéis}} esto.

fr.L: L’ardeur de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne se détournera pas \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait agi et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait accompli les desseins de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur. \q Dans la suite des jours, vous le comprendrez.
fr.B: La colère ardente {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne s’apaisera pas \q avant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait pleinement exécuté ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a décidé dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cœur. \q Dans les jours à venir, vous le comprendrez.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne cessera pas d’être violemment en colère \q avant d’avoir fait tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prévu. \q Plus tard, vous comprendrez cela.

sw.L: Hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haitarudi nyuma \q mpaka atakapotenda na mpaka atakapotimiza makusudi ya moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Katika siku za mwisho mtalifahamu.
sw.B: Hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haitageuka \q mpaka atakapotimiza kabisa yale aliyokusudia moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. \q Katika siku zijazo mtalielewa jambo hili.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hataacha kukasirika vikali \q mpaka atakapokuwa amefanya yote aliyopanga. \q Baadaye mtalielewa jambo hili.

vi.L: Cơn giận nóng nảy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không quay lại \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm và đã thực hiện xong các ý định trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Trong những ngày sau rốt, các ngươi sẽ hiểu điều ấy.
vi.B: Cơn giận dữ dội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không nguôi \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thực hiện trọn vẹn những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định trong lòng. \q Trong những ngày sắp đến, các ngươi sẽ hiểu điều này.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không thôi giận dữ \q cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm xong mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định. \q Về sau, các ngươi sẽ hiểu điều này.

decisions.choice: the fierce anger: a fuller phrase than 23:20
decisions.reason: 23:20 has "the anger of the LORD"; here it is "the burning of the anger", his fierce anger, as in 4:8 and 25:37. See also the note at verse 23.

decisions.choice: the latter days: the time to come, after the judgment
decisions.reason: As in 23:20, the phrase means the later part of time, the future as seen from now (48:47; 49:39). Then the people will see what the LORD intended.

decisions.choice: you will understand it: you (plural), the people, will understand the LORD's purpose
decisions.reason: "It" is the LORD's storm and the plan behind it. Unlike 23:20, the verb is not strengthened by the noun "understanding".

decisions.choice: the wording of 23:20, with "fierce" added and "clearly" left out
decisions.reason: Each level follows its wording from 23:20 closely, changing what the Hebrew changes (m1, m3); Balanced keeps the 23:20 wording but for "fierce" and the last line.
